name: Naapbooks Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2017, Naapbooks Ltd is in the business of software development[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
NBL is a CMMI Level 3 and ISO 9001 & 27001 certified IT solutions provider, offering financial services and e-governance platforms, including ERP systems and financial management solutions. The company develops Fintech apps, cloud consulting, blockchain apps, mobile & web apps, and embedded applications. It also offers end-to-end software services, covering design, development, maintenance, debugging, and consulting.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 69.5% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 173 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -9.70%
Working capital days have increased from 398 days to 675 days
